en.title: OneK Research Internship Program
en.subtitle: Tropical Ecology, Biodiversity Monitoring and Conservation Research

blocks.text: The OneK Research Internship Program provides students and early-career conservationists with hands-on experience in tropical ecology, biodiversity monitoring, habitat restoration, and field-based scientific research.

Located within a protected lowland rainforest ecosystem in Costa Rica, OneK Biological Station serves as a living outdoor laboratory where participants contribute directly to ongoing conservation and ecological monitoring projects.
Unlike traditional volunteer programs, this internship emphasizes scientific observation, data collection, field methodology, and ecological analysis.
Participants gain practical experience while contributing meaningful data to long-term biodiversity and conservation initiatives.
OneK maintains ongoing biodiversity surveys across multiple taxonomic groups.

zh.title: OneK 科研实习项目
zh.subtitle: 热带生态学、生物多样性监测与自然保护实践

blocks.text: OneK 科研实习项目（Research Internship Program）旨在为大学生、研究生及青年科研工作者提供深入热带雨林开展生态研究与保护实践的机会。
项目依托哥斯达黎加 OneK 生物站开展，结合长期生态监测、生物多样性调查、生态恢复和自然保护工作，让参与者在真实野外环境中学习科学研究方法，并参与长期数据积累与保护实践。
与传统志愿者项目不同，本项目更加注重科研能力培养、监测技术训练和独立研究能力提升。

The OneK Conservation Volunteer Program offers participants a unique opportunity to become directly involved in tropical rainforest conservation in Costa Rica.

Located within a protected lowland rainforest ecosystem, OneK Biological Station is dedicated to biodiversity conservation, habitat restoration, wildlife monitoring, environmental education, and long-term ecosystem protection.
Unlike traditional tourism experiences, this program allows volunteers to contribute to real conservation work while learning about one of the most biodiverse ecosystems on Earth.
Volunteers work alongside conservation staff and researchers, helping protect wildlife and restore habitats while gaining a deeper understanding of tropical ecology.
OneK is not a zoo, wildlife park, or tourist attraction.

en.title: OneK Youth Rainforest Camp
en.subtitle: Inspiring the Next Generation of Conservationists

blocks.text: The OneK Youth Rainforest Camp is an immersive nature education program designed to connect young people with one of the most biodiverse ecosystems on Earth.

Hosted at OneK Biological Station in the tropical rainforest of Costa Rica, the program combines scientific exploration, wildlife observation, environmental education, and hands-on conservation experiences.
Participants learn directly from nature while developing curiosity, ecological understanding, critical thinking, and a lifelong appreciation for biodiversity.
This is not a traditional summer camp.
It is an opportunity to become a young explorer, field naturalist, and future conservation leader.
Children protect what they understand.
They understand what they experience.

By spending time in the rainforest, observing wildlife, and participating in real conservation activities, young people gain a deeper connection with nature and a better understanding of humanity’s relationship with the natural world.
Our goal is not only to teach ecology.
Our goal is to inspire future conservationists.
Unlike many outdoor camps, OneK is an active conservation area and biological station.
Participants are immersed in a real rainforest environment where biodiversity research, habitat restoration, wildlife monitoring, and environmental education occur every day.
Young explorers become part of an ongoing conservation story.

We do not aim to create tourists.

We do not simply teach children about nature.

Because every future conservationist begins with a moment of wonder.

项目依托哥斯达黎加 OneK 生物站开展，通过雨林观察、野外探索、科学实践和生态保护活动，让孩子们走进真实的热带雨林，认识丰富多样的生命，理解生态系统的运行规律，并建立尊重自然、保护自然的价值观。
这不是普通的夏令营。
而是一场成为“小小自然学家”的成长之旅。
孩子们会保护他们所理解的事物。
而理解，来自亲身体验。
当孩子们走进雨林、观察野生动物、参与保护实践时，他们会逐渐理解人与自然之间的关系，并形成对生命的尊重与责任感。
OneK 希望培养的不仅是自然爱好者，更是未来的自然保护者。
OneK 不仅是一片雨林。
更是一座正在持续开展保护工作的生物站。
